paper.title: ClockRoPE: Random Fourier Rotations for Temporal Routine Modeling
paper.abstract: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has been widely adopted in transformer-based large language models. However, its log-linear frequency schedule, originally designed to produce long-term attention decay, limits its adoption in domains with more complex distance-correlation patterns, such as temporal periodicity in sequential recommendation. We investigate the expressiveness of general query/key rotations and find that any normalized continuous positive-definite attention modulation function can b

summary.core_problem: 标准RoPE采用对数线性频率调度，原生设计目标是实现长期注意力衰减，适配语言建模的距离相关性模式；但在序列推荐等存在时间周期性的领域，这种单调衰减的频率设计无法捕捉复杂的距离-相关性模式，例如用户每日/每周周期行为的相关性。
summary.importance: 从傅里叶分析角度给出了RoPE类旋转位置编码的通用表达能力结论，证明任意归一化连续正定注意力调制函数都可通过从其傅里叶变换分布采样频率的随机旋转来无偏近似，为不同领域定制位置编码频率提供了理论框架。该结论对LLM位置编码的定制化设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心分为两层：1）随机傅里叶旋转（RFR）理论：基于Bochner定理，若目标注意力调制函数是归一化连续正定函数，其傅里叶变换是合法概率密度；从该密度中独立采样RoPE的旋转频率，构造的旋转注意力得分就是调制后注意力的无偏估计。2）ClockRoPE：针对用户行为的日/周周期性，构造周期型注意力调制函数，通过RFR采样对应的频率，使模型注意力在相同时段/星期的交互对上有更高的得分上界，实现时间routine建模。
summary.experiments: 在生产级生成式检索系统中完成验证，ClockRoPE可提升模型的routine感知能力与整体用户价值；对比实验显示标准RoPE的注意力集中在近期交互上，无法显式呈现日周期性模式。现有文本未披露具体量化提升数值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点在第3章方法论的随机傅里叶旋转理论推导，以及第4章中标准RoPE与ClockRoPE的注意力分布对比实验；预计阅读时间20~30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RoPE uses a log-linear frequency schedule designed to produce long-term attention decay, which fits the distance-correlation patterns of language modeling. However, this monotonically decaying frequency design fails to capture complex distance-correlation patterns — such as daily or weekly periodicity in user behavior — in domains like sequential recommendation.
summary_en.importance: The work provides a general Fourier-analytic perspective on the expressiveness of RoPE-style rotary position embeddings. It proves that any normalized continuous positive-definite attention modulation function can be unbiasedly approximated by random rotations with frequencies sampled from the function's Fourier transform. This theoretical framework supports customized position encoding design across domains, and is relevant to LLM position encoding research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two core components: 1) Random Fourier Rotations (RFR): Based on Bochner's theorem, the Fourier transform of a normalized continuous positive-definite kernel is a valid probability density. Sampling RoPE rotation frequencies i.i.d. from this density yields an unbiased estimator of the attention score modulated by the target kernel. 2) ClockRoPE: For temporal periodicity in user behavior, periodic attention modulation functions are defined, and their Fourier transforms are used to sample rotation frequencies. This gives higher attention score upper bounds for interaction pairs at the same hour of day or day of week, enabling routine modeling.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in a production-scale generative retrieval system, where ClockRoPE improves routine awareness and overall user value. Comparative experiments show standard RoPE concentrates attention on recent interactions and does not explicitly capture daily periodicity patterns. No specific quantitative improvement numbers are disclosed in the available text.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the theoretical derivation of Random Fourier Rotations in Section 3, and the attention distribution comparison between standard RoPE and ClockRoPE in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: RoPE表达能力的理论边界有参考价值，重点看§3傅里叶旋转逼近证明，时序LLM可直接复用频率设计思路。
recommendation.en: The theoretical expressiveness bound of RoPE is informative; focus on §3 Fourier rotation approximation proof, and the frequency design is directly reusable for temporal LLMs.

paper.title: InferScale: GPU-Native KV Injection for Personalized LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed with persistent personalized context, such as accumulated memory profiles or long conversation histories, that is shared across a user's many requests. Production memory systems (e.g., Mem0, MemGPT, and Zep) retrieve a relevant subset of this memory and inject it into the prompt, forcing the serving engine to repeatedly prefill the same content. As the retrieval budget grows, time-to-first-token (TTFT) increases even though the underlying memory is

summary.core_problem: 解决个性化 LLM 服务中持久用户记忆被反复塞入 prompt，导致重复 prefill 和 TTFT 增长的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统优化。它关注生产环境里长期记忆、用户画像和历史对话被多次复用的场景，尝试把这些上下文从文本 prompt 转为可复用 KV state。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于理解 serving 侧对长上下文和位置编码的真实约束。
summary.technical_approach: InferScale 预先为每条 memory fact 计算 KV 表示，并与语义 embedding 一起存放在 GPU 上。请求到来时，系统检索相关 fact，并把对应 KV 直接注入 vLLM 的 paged cache，避免重新 prefill 文本。为处理 RoPE 下动态拼接 memory 的位置问题，论文提出 Chunked RoPE：存储旋转前的 key，在注入时按目标 chunk 位置重新施加旋转。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体吞吐、TTFT、显存或延迟数字。可确认的实验对象是个性化 memory serving 场景，基线是传统 retrieval-then-prompt-prefill 方式以及 vLLM paged cache 服务路径。效果幅度需要读正文表格确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses repeated prefill overhead in personalized LLM serving, where persistent user memory is repeatedly injected into prompts and increases time-to-first-token.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-system optimization. It targets production settings with reusable long-lived context such as user profiles and conversation histories, replacing text prompt reinjection with reusable KV state. For pretraining researchers, the indirect value is in understanding serving-side constraints on long context and positional encodings.
summary_en.technical_approach: InferScale precomputes the KV representation of each memory fact and stores it on GPU together with a semantic embedding. At request time, the system retrieves relevant facts and directly injects their KV into vLLM's paged cache, avoiding repeated text prefill. To support dynamically assembled memories under RoPE, the paper introduces Chunked RoPE: keys are stored before rotation and rotated at injection time according to their target chunk positions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete throughput, TTFT, memory, or latency numbers. The evaluated setting is personalized memory serving, with retrieval-then-prompt-prefill and vLLM paged-cache serving as the relevant baselines. The actual improvement magnitude needs to be checked in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Chunked RoPE 和 KV 注入接口；这是 serving trick，不会改变长上下文预训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Read only Chunked RoPE and the KV injection path; this is a serving trick, not a long-context pretraining prior.

paper.title: Through the Bottleneck: How Multi-head Latent Attention Separates Content from Position in Language Models
paper.abstract: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), introduced in DeepSeek-V2, compresses key-value pairs through a shared low-rank bottleneck (cKV), achieving 81% KV-cache reduction during inference. Despite its adoption in massive production models, no prior work has studied what information this bottleneck preserves or discards, nor how it reshapes internal transformer circuits. We present the first comprehensive mechanistic interpretability study of MLA, training a 114M-parameter transformer (pretrained on a

summary.core_problem: DeepSeek-V2提出的多头潜在注意力（MLA）通过共享低秩cKV瓶颈压缩KV实现高效推理，但尚无研究揭示该瓶颈的信息保留/丢弃机制及对Transformer内部电路的重塑作用。
summary.importance: 原理分析（首个针对MLA的全面机制可解释性研究），验证了MLA的核心设计假设，为KV压缩架构和预训练位置编码设计提供了实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 训练114M参数Transformer（网页/代码/数学混合语料预训练，TinyStories微调），采用SVD、注意力头分类、线性探测、扰动归因分析等方法拆解MLA的cKV瓶颈与内部电路。
summary.experiments: 训练114M参数Transformer；核心发现：1）cKV瓶颈学习纯内容表征，实体身份保留率98%，丢弃位置信息，验证了MLA通过RoPE实现内容-位置分离的设计；2）归纳头集中在第12层，不同于常规Transformer的分布式分布。
summary.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Madras、P P Savani University；研究对象为DeepSeek-V2核心架构MLA，未披露知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) introduced in DeepSeek-V2 compresses KV pairs via a shared low-rank cKV bottleneck for efficient inference, but no prior work has studied what information this bottleneck preserves/discards or how it reshapes internal transformer circuits.
summary_en.importance: First comprehensive mechanistic interpretability study of MLA, validates core design assumptions of MLA, and provides empirical evidence for KV compression architecture and pretraining position encoding design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a 114M-parameter transformer (pretrained on web/code/math mixture, fine-tuned on TinyStories), and analyzes MLA's cKV bottleneck and internal circuits via SVD, attention head taxonomy, linear probing, and disruption-attribution analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Trains a 114M-parameter transformer; key findings: 1) The cKV bottleneck learns pure content representations with 98% entity identity retention and discards positional information, validating MLA's content-position separation via RoPE; 2) Induction heads are concentrated in Layer 12, unlike distributed formation in standard transformers.
summary_en.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Madras, P P Savani University; research object is the core MLA architecture of DeepSeek-V2, no notable authors disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 首个MLA机制分析，验证了低秩KV瓶颈分离内容/位置的设计假设，应立刻在内部KV压缩架构消融中参考其SVD和扰动分析方法。
recommendation.en: First mechanistic analysis of MLA, validating the low-rank KV bottleneck's content-position separation design; immediately reference its SVD and perturbation analysis methods in internal KV compression ablations.

paper.title: Anti-Periodic Positional Encoding: Möbius Boundary Conditions Make In-Context Retrieval Reliable
paper.abstract: Möbius RoPE is a rotary positional encoding built on the anti-periodic frequency ladder $θ_i=π(2i+1)/N$: every rotation plane advances by an odd multiple of $π$ across the training context, so the positional holonomy is $-1$ and the two ends of the sequence are deterministically coupled through a closed-form Dirichlet "dipole"; to our knowledge this is the first anti-periodic boundary condition in positional encoding. We verify the theory numerically to $\sim 10^{-6}$ and pretrain 48 models span

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 RoPE 预训练模型在 in-context retrieval 上的随机种子不稳定问题：loss 和 perplexity 看起来正常，但 needle-in-a-haystack 能力可能因 seed 大幅波动。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究有明确启发。它指出短上下文预训练里的检索能力不是简单由 perplexity 决定，而会受到 positional encoding 几何结构和随机种子的强影响。作者提出的 Möbius RoPE 不增加参数和 FLOPs，只替换部分 attention heads 的频率表，却显著降低 retrieval variance。这类结果提醒预训练实验不能只看 loss curve 和 perplexity；位置编码可能改变模型是否稳定学到长距离绑定关系。贡献类型是 positional encoding 设计加系统性小规模预训练实验，量级不是大模型能力提升，而是训练可靠性和评测诊断上的改进。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 anti-periodic positional encoding。标准 RoPE 使用几何频率 θ_i=10000^{-2i/d_h}，不同旋转平面没有短公共周期，长距离相位会出现不规则漂移。Möbius RoPE 改用 θ_i=π(2i+1)/N，其中 N 固定为训练上下文长度。这样每个二维旋转平面跨过 N 个位置后都旋转奇数倍 π，整体 holonomy 为 -I，也就是序列两端带符号翻转地耦合。理论上，这会产生 Dirichlet-kernel 形式的位置注意力响应：中间区域较安静，端点之间有确定性 dipole 结构；长度外推时位置系数有界，并呈 2N 周期。由于 anti-periodic 先验较强，作者没有替换全部 heads，而是在 hybrid 设置中只给 25% heads 使用 Möbius frequencies，其余保持标准 RoPE。这个设计不增加参数、不增加 FLOPs，只改变正余弦表。
summary.experiments: 实验规模较扎实。作者预训练了 48 个模型，覆盖 160M-class 和 410M-class 两档；每个模型使用 2B FineWeb-Edu tokens。160M 设置中，6 个标准 RoPE seed 的 NIAH 准确率在 512 token 上从 14% 到 98% 不等，说明 seed lottery 很严重；perplexity 与 retrieval 的相关性很弱，RoPE-vs-hybrid 12 个模型中相关系数只有 +0.206。Hybrid Möbius 在 perplexity 上基本不损失，29.66 vs. 标准 RoPE 29.72；但在 L=512 的 NIAH 上平均达到 90.3±5.7%，并把跨 seed 方差压低，原始方差比约 30.8×，robust variance tests p=0.013–0.029，最差 seed 为 86% vs. 标准 RoPE 的 14%。410M 设置也复现了方差降低：L=2048 时 SD 为 6.5% vs. 16.5%，Levene p=0.040。机制控制实验显示，覆盖相同低频带但没有 holonomy 的 aperiodic ladder 没有复现可靠性收益；periodic ladder，即 holonomy +1，只得到较弱效果，方差比约 3.1×且不显著。冻结 hybrid 权重、只在评测时把频率表换回标准 RoPE，会让 L=512 retrieval 从 90.3% 降到 41.7%，远离 query 的 needle 下降更大，depth 0.1 下降 55 pp，depth 0.9 下降 36 pp。NoPE 在短上下文检索上也强，L=512 为 95.2±4.0%，但 perplexity 付出约 13% 代价，33.66 vs. 29.66–29.72，并且在训练长度和外推上不稳。作者还观察到 capacity–scale interaction：160M 下把 Möbius heads 分散到 N∈{512,1024,2048} 的多尺度 ladder 比单尺度差约 30 pp，p=0.015；410M 下多尺度 ladder 反而在多长度检索和 extrapolation perplexity 上更好，ppl@4096 为 35.7 vs. 38.7，Welch p=0.006。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精，预计 45–60 分钟。先看理论部分关于 anti-periodic ladder、-1 holonomy、Dirichlet kernel 和 2N 周期外推的推导，理解这个位置编码为什么会加强端到端绑定，而不是只是在频率范围上做低频增强。然后看 §5.2 的 seed variance 结果，这是论文最核心的实验现象。§5.3 的 aperiodic/periodic/NoPE 控制和评测时频率表替换 ablation 最值得细看，它把收益从“频率变低了”区分到“anti-periodic boundary condition 起作用”。§5.4 的 410M 结果用于判断现象是否随规模保持。预训练实验设计上，可以借鉴它把 perplexity、NIAH mean、seed variance、worst-seed floor 分开报告的方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a reliability failure in pretrained RoPE language models: two runs can have similar loss and perplexity, yet differ sharply in in-context retrieval because the learned retrieval behavior is highly seed-dependent.
summary_en.importance: The result is relevant to pretraining because it separates language-modeling quality from retrieval reliability. Perplexity alone does not reveal whether a model has learned robust long-range binding inside the context window. The proposed Möbius RoPE changes only the positional frequency table for a subset of attention heads, with no additional parameters or FLOPs, yet strongly reduces seed-to-seed variance in needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. The contribution is best viewed as a positional-encoding and pretraining-diagnostics study: it does not claim a broad capability jump, but it gives a concrete mechanism and a careful experimental protocol for making retrieval more reliable.
summary_en.technical_approach: Möbius RoPE replaces the standard geometric RoPE ladder θ_i=10000^{-2i/d_h} with an anti-periodic ladder θ_i=π(2i+1)/N, where N is tied to the training context length. After N positions, every two-dimensional rotation plane has advanced by an odd multiple of π, so the combined positional transform has holonomy -I. This creates a signed coupling between the two ends of the sequence. The theory predicts a Dirichlet-kernel positional attention profile, a quiet interior response, an endpoint dipole, and bounded 2N-periodic behavior under length extrapolation. Because this prior is strong, the main hybrid configuration applies Möbius frequencies to only 25% of attention heads and leaves the rest on standard RoPE. The implementation is just a different sine-cosine table for those heads.
summary_en.experiments: The study pretrains 48 models across 160M-class and 410M-class settings, using 2B FineWeb-Edu tokens per run. At 160M, six standard RoPE seeds show a severe seed lottery: NIAH accuracy at length 512 ranges from 14% to 98%, while perplexity gives little warning. Across the 12 RoPE-vs-hybrid models, the correlation between perplexity and retrieval is only +0.206. The hybrid Möbius arm keeps perplexity essentially unchanged, 29.66 versus 29.72 for standard RoPE, but reaches 90.3±5.7% NIAH accuracy at length 512 and greatly reduces seed variance. The raw variance ratio at L=512 is about 30.8×, robust variance tests give p=0.013–0.029, and the worst seed improves from 14% to 86%. At 410M, the variance reduction also appears: at L=2048, the standard deviation is 6.5% for hybrid versus 16.5% for RoPE, with Levene p=0.040. Mechanism controls are important. An aperiodic ladder over the same low-frequency band does not reproduce the effect; a periodic integer-harmonic ladder with holonomy +1 gives only a weaker, non-significant reduction. Swapping the trained hybrid models back to the standard RoPE frequency table at evaluation time drops L=512 retrieval from 90.3% to 41.7%, with larger damage for needles far from the query. NoPE gives strong short-context retrieval, 95.2±4.0% at L=512, but pays a 13% perplexity penalty and extrapolates poorly. The paper also reports a scale interaction: at 160M, distributing Möbius heads across N∈{512,1024,2048} hurts by about 30 points, while at 410M the multi-scale ladder improves both retrieval and extrapolation perplexity, with ppl@4096 of 35.7 versus 38.7.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 45–60 minute skim with attention to a few key parts. Read the theory section on anti-periodicity, -1 holonomy, the Dirichlet-kernel profile, and bounded 2N-periodic extrapolation; this is where the method differs from simply adding lower RoPE frequencies. Then read the seed-variance results in §5.2, since that is the central empirical finding. The most useful evidence is in §5.3: the aperiodic and periodic controls, the NoPE comparison, and the frozen-weight frequency-table ablation. §5.4 is worth checking to see how the effect changes at 410M and why multi-scale allocation may need more capacity. For pretraining practice, the reporting format is as useful as the method: mean retrieval, worst-seed retrieval, variance, perplexity, and extrapolation should be treated as separate signals.

recommendation.zh: 反周期边界RoPE在不损失困惑度的前提下大幅降低上下文检索方差，核心结论值得在内部位置编码消融实验中复现验证。
recommendation.en: Anti-periodic RoPE cuts in-context retrieval variance without perplexity loss; core findings are worth replicating in internal positional encoding ablation studies.

paper.title: AdaRoPE: Not All Attention Heads Should Rotate and Scale Equally
paper.abstract: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is widely adopted in Transformers to encode positional information, yet standard implementations enforce a uniform frequency schedule and scaling across all attention heads. Using simplified retrieval tasks and length generalization scenarios, we show -- both empirically and theoretically -- that heads with different functional roles require distinct frequency ranges and attention scaling factors to operate effectively. Ignoring this structure leads to suboptimal

summary.core_problem: 标准 RoPE 对所有 attention head 使用同一套频率表和缩放规则，可能不适合不同 head 在检索、位置建模和长上下文泛化中的不同功能分工。
summary.importance: 这是一个直接作用于 LLM 架构和长上下文预训练的改动。贡献不在于提出新的训练数据或 recipe，而是把 RoPE 的频率和 attention scaling 从全局固定设计改成 head-wise 可学习设计，挑战了“所有 head 共享同一位置编码谱”的默认做法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用简化检索任务和长度泛化场景分析不同 head 对旋转频率范围和 attention 缩放因子的需求差异，再提出 AdaRoPE：为每个 attention head 配置可学习的 rotation frequencies 和 attention scaling factors。它属于对 RoPE 参数化方式的结构性改造，也可用于上下文扩展场景，修正 YaRN 等方法中的统一频率缩放和统一 attention 缩放假设。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖简化检索任务、长度泛化场景，以及采用 AdaRoPE 预训练的 LLM。摘要称 AdaRoPE 稳定优于已有 RoPE 变体，包括 partial RoPE 和 NoPE baseline；在上下文扩展中，统一频率和 attention scaling 的方法表现为次优。给定信息中未提供模型规模、训练 token 数和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RoPE applies the same frequency schedule and scaling rule to all attention heads, which may mismatch the different functional roles heads play in retrieval, position tracking, and long-context generalization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is directly relevant to LLM architecture and long-context pretraining. It changes the parameterization of positional encoding from a global fixed spectrum to head-wise learnable frequency and attention scaling, questioning the default assumption that all heads should share the same positional spectrum.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes simplified retrieval and length-generalization settings to show that heads need different frequency ranges and scaling factors. AdaRoPE then assigns learnable rotation frequencies and attention scaling factors to each attention head. The same idea is also applied to context extension, where it argues against uniform frequency and attention scaling used by methods such as YaRN.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include synthetic retrieval tasks, length-generalization scenarios, and LLMs pretrained with AdaRoPE. The abstract reports consistent gains over RoPE variants including partial RoPE and NoPE baselines, and finds uniform scaling suboptimal for context extension. Model sizes, token budgets, and exact effect sizes are not available in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 头级 RoPE 参数化值得在长上下文预训练消融里复现；若收益只来自扩参，结论会打折。
recommendation.en: Head-wise RoPE parameterization is worth reproducing in long-context pretraining ablations; the claim weakens if the gain mostly comes from extra parameters.

paper.title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-video question answering requires a model to preserve visual evidence over time without repeatedly reprocessing the same video. A practical approach is to store the vision-language model's internal key-value (KV) cache for each video chunk and retrieve that state at query time. However, independently cached video chunks do not compose correctly: every chunk is prefilled from local rotary position zero, so naive concatenation collides temporal phases and removes the global order required for

summary.core_problem: 长视频 VLM 中，将视频分块独立预填充得到的 KV cache 直接拼接会导致多模态 RoPE 的时空位置冲突，无法支持跨块时序推理。
summary.importance: 指出多模态 RoPE（尤其是时空联合坐标）下 naive KV 拼接的几何不一致问题，给出训练无关的修复方案，对长视频/长上下文 KV cache 复用有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ChronoStitch 在 post-rotary key 空间将各 chunk 的 KV 重映射到统一的全局三轴（time/height/width）RoPE 坐标系，而不是做一维标量 re-index；分析了一维 re-index 在视觉 token 上破坏空间结构的原因。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出完整模型与数据集规模，核心验证点是重基后跨 chunk 时序问题（先后、计数、变化）在不重训前提下恢复全局顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-video VLMs, naively concatenating independently prefilled KV caches across video chunks causes multimodal RoPE phase collisions across time and space, breaking cross-chunk temporal reasoning.
summary_en.importance: It identifies a geometric inconsistency of naive KV stitching under joint spatio-temporal multimodal RoPE and proposes a training-free fix, relevant to long-context KV reuse for video LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChronoStitch re-bases stored post-rotary keys onto a unified global three-axis RoPE coordinate system (time, height, width), showing why 1D scalar re-indexing is geometrically inconsistent for visual tokens and scrambles spatial order.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify exact model sizes and datasets; the stated claim is that re-basing recovers global ordering across chunks without retraining, enabling questions about event order, frequency, and change.

recommendation.zh: 训练无关的 KV stitching 思路实用，但分析只在多模态 RoPE 几何层面，建议只看 §3 的坐标系重基推导，正文实验当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a training-free KV stitching trick, but the analysis stays at multimodal RoPE geometry; read §3 for the re-basing argument and treat experiments as a weak signal.

paper.title: ShotPlan: Cinematic Video Generation with Learnable Planning Token
paper.abstract: Current video generation models achieve impressive results in single-shot generation, yet remain limited in cinematic video generation, where coherent narratives and effective multi-shot composition require explicit shot planning. To address this challenge, we propose ShotPlan, a framework for explicit multi-shot cinematic video generation built upon a video diffusion foundation model. Our method introduces learnable planning tokens that capture shot-level transition cues and can be seamlessly i

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型仅擅长单镜头生成，在需要连贯叙事和多镜头组合的电影级视频生成上缺乏显式镜头规划能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出显式多镜头电影级视频生成框架，通过可学习规划token实现镜头转场的细粒度控制。
summary.technical_approach: 基于视频扩散基座模型，引入捕捉镜头级转场线索的可学习规划token，与原生生成token融合以控制转场时间戳；为规划token配备分数时间旋转位置编码（FRoPE），实现帧级转场建模。
summary.experiments: 在电影级视频生成任务上显著优于现有方法，镜头管理更灵活，跨镜头一致性更强。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video generation models excel at single-shot generation but lack explicit shot planning for cinematic video production that requires coherent narratives and multi-shot composition.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes an explicit multi-shot cinematic video generation framework with learnable planning tokens for fine-grained transition control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on a video diffusion foundation model, introduces learnable planning tokens that capture shot-level transition cues and integrate with native generation tokens to control transition timestamps; equips planning tokens with Fractional Temporal Rotary Position Embedding (FRoPE) for frame-level transition modeling.
summary_en.experiments: Significantly outperforms existing cinematic video generation methods, with more flexible shot management and stronger inter-shot consistency.

recommendation.zh: 规划token+FRoPE的时序控制思路对长文本多段生成有微弱参考价值，仅看方法节即可，整体属视频生成领域工作。
recommendation.en: Planning token + FRoPE temporal control offers minor inspiration for long-text multi-segment generation; methods section only.

paper.title: Frontier Language Models Struggle to Copy: Text Can Be Better Viewed in 2D
paper.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) can solve advanced reasoning problems in seconds, we show that even frontier models fail to perform a much simpler operation: exactly copying an input string that lies well within their context windows. We attribute this failure to positional encodings in Transformer architectures, whose inductive bias favors copying through a shortcut based on matching local contexts rather than carefully locating the corresponding input positions. To address this issue, we in

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解“前沿 LLM 在上下文窗口内仍会失败的精确复制（copy）”现象，尤其是在输入包含大量重复子串时；进一步追问失败是否来自 Transformer 位置编码（尤其 RoPE）的归纳偏置，使模型倾向用“局部上下文匹配的捷径”（类似 induction head）而不是按位置对齐去取回对应 token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于“复制任务本身”，而在于它把一个常被忽略的能力缺口（精确字符串操作/格式搬运）追溯到位置编码的结构性偏置，并给出一个可落地的替代位置表示（2D-RoPE）。这类缺口会外溢到工具调用参数搬运、结构化输出、代码/配置片段重排等场景；如果结论成立，它提示：仅靠扩大模型与数据，某些“看似低级但要求精确对齐”的能力可能被 RoPE 的捷径学习长期拖累，需要在 pretrain 架构归纳偏置层面修补。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 失败机理假设：模型复制不是用绝对索引 i 去取输入第 i 个符号，而更像 induction head：在上下文里找“局部 n-gram 相似”的先前片段，再预测其后继 token。重复子串会制造多解匹配，导致注意力被吸走，从而复制出错。
2) 2D 视角：把“输入行 + 输出行”看成二维网格。若仍用 1D 序列，输出位置 y_k 需要从一个依赖输入长度 n 的偏移处取 x_k；相对位置编码（RoPE）更擅长表达固定偏移检索，因此会诱导模型走捷径。若排成两行，y_k 只需取同一列（或固定列偏移）的 token，结构更简单。
3) 2D-RoPE：以换行符 <\n> 作为行分隔，把文本映射到 (row_id, col_id)。在注意力里对两个轴分别施加 RoPE（借鉴视觉模型对 2D RoPE 的用法），使“跨行同列对齐”成为更强的归纳偏置。
4) 理论与可解释性：给出一层 Transformer + 2D-RoPE 可表示二元复制并实现长度泛化的证明；并进一步论证在只见过长度 ≤L 的训练分布上，某些全局最优解可泛化到多项式长度。配合机制分析，强调 RoPE 下注意力更易被局部重复吸引，而 2D-RoPE 更容易形成干净的列对齐检索。
5) 从合成任务到真实 LM：不仅在 copy 专项训练上验证，还在 DCLM 上做真实语言模型预训练（350M–1.4B），再微调评估复制类任务，检查是否在不牺牲常识推理的前提下改善复制与 OOD/长度泛化。另提出 Auto-2D-RoPE：当自然文档的 2D 结构不总由显式换行给出时，自动推断/构造行分割以获得 2D 坐标（全文此处尚未展开完，但方向明确）。
summary.experiments:
1) 现实模型现象：对 GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Pro 等做 copy 测试，在“远小于上下文长度”的输入上仍出现显著失败；长度越长准确率越低，常低于 50%。
2) 重复度相关：在 Python List Conversion（含周期波形数据，重复子串多）等设置下，复制准确率与输入重复度负相关。
3) 合成二元复制长度泛化：训练于短序列，测试长序列。文中给出极端泛化倍数：一层 2D-RoPE 模型可做到约 1000× 的长度泛化仍保持完美复制；12 层模型可保持约 100× 的完美复制（这里的“×”是相对训练长度的倍数）。
4) 真实预训练验证：在 DCLM 上预训练 350M–1.4B 的 2D-RoPE LM，微调后在 copy 任务上表现出长度泛化与分布外泛化，同时常识推理任务与 RoPE 大体相当（全文未给出你提供片段中的具体分数表，但实验设计意图是“copy 提升不以通用能力为代价”。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“现象→机理→结构→验证”顺序读：
- 先看 Figure 1/2（或对应实验图）：确认复制失败的规模、随长度与重复度的变化趋势。
- 精读第 3 节（作者提到的 expressivity theory + mechanistic interpretability）：这里决定了论文是否真的把问题钉在 RoPE 归纳偏置/induction head 捷径上，而不是数据或解码细节。
- 重点看 2D-RoPE 的定义细节：如何从 token 序列得到 (row,col)，两个轴的 RoPE 如何组合进 QK 旋转，是否引入额外超参/实现复杂度。
- 读合成任务的长度泛化设置：训练长度 L、测试长度范围、是否控制重复模式、是否存在提示模板导致的固定列偏移。
- 再看 DCLM 预训练与微调部分：关注是否需要特殊数据格式（换行密度）、对困惑度/下游基准的影响、以及 Auto-2D-RoPE 在无显式换行时的鲁棒性假设。

summary_en.core_problem: Diagnose and fix a surprising failure mode: frontier LLMs often cannot exactly copy an input string even when it fits well within the context window, especially when the input contains repeated substrings. The paper attributes this to the inductive bias of positional encodings (notably RoPE), which encourages a local-context matching shortcut (induction-head-like) instead of position-aligned retrieval.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the architectural diagnosis: scaling alone may not resolve certain “precision alignment” behaviors (exact copying, format transduction, parameter/argument transfer for tool use) if the positional encoding biases the model toward ambiguous local matches. 2D-RoPE is a concrete proposal to inject a stronger alignment bias while aiming to keep general LM quality intact, and the work connects mechanistic interpretability claims to a design change that can be tested in real pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Mechanism hypothesis: copying is implemented via induction-head-like pattern matching—find a previous occurrence of a similar local context and emit the following token—so repeated substrings create competing matches and derail exact copying.
2) 2D reframing: represent “input then output” as a 2-row grid. In 1D, producing y_k requires retrieving x_k at an offset that depends on input length n, which is awkward for relative encodings like RoPE. In 2D, y_k can attend to the same column (or a fixed column shift), making the retrieval rule length-invariant.
3) 2D-RoPE: assign each token a (row_id, col_id) using newline as a row separator; apply RoPE along both axes (inspired by 2D RoPE in vision transformers) so column-wise alignment becomes an easy-to-learn attention pattern.
4) Theory + interpretability: prove a 1-layer Transformer with 2D-RoPE can represent binary copy with length generalization; argue certain global minima trained up to length L generalize to polynomially longer sequences. Mechanistic evidence supports that RoPE attention is attracted to locally similar substrings, while 2D-RoPE yields cleaner alignment.
5) Beyond synthetic: pretrain 2D-RoPE LMs (350M–1.4B) on DCLM, then finetune for copy tasks to test whether the benefit survives real LM training without hurting commonsense reasoning. Propose Auto-2D-RoPE to handle documents where 2D structure is not explicitly marked by line breaks.
summary_en.experiments:
1) Frontier-model evaluation: GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Pro show substantial copy failures on inputs well within context; accuracy degrades with length and can drop below 50%.
2) Repetition sensitivity: copy accuracy is negatively correlated with repetition in the input (e.g., periodic synthetic data in a Python list conversion task).
3) Synthetic binary copy length generalization: 1-layer 2D-RoPE achieves perfect copying with ~1000× length generalization; 12-layer models maintain perfect performance up to ~100×.
4) Real pretraining check: 350M–1.4B 2D-RoPE models pretrained on DCLM, after finetuning, show length and OOD generalization on copy tasks while keeping commonsense reasoning roughly comparable to RoPE (the provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
- Start with the empirical figures showing failure rates vs length and vs repetition; they justify the problem and the induction-head shortcut hypothesis.
- Focus on the expressivity/mechanistic section: it’s the crux of the causal claim linking RoPE to ambiguous local matching.
- Study the exact 2D-RoPE formulation (row/col assignment, how 2D rotations are applied in attention) and what it changes in implementation cost.
- Inspect the synthetic generalization protocol (train length L, test lengths, repetition patterns, prompt templates) to ensure the reported 100×/1000× generalization is not an artifact.
- Finally, check the DCLM pretraining results and the assumptions behind Auto-2D-RoPE (how robust it is when newline structure is weak or noisy).

recommendation.zh: 只看复制实验和 2D-RoPE 构造即可；它会改变对“长上下文=可精确搬运文本”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the copying setup and 2D-RoPE construction; it weakens the default assumption that long context implies reliable verbatim transport.

paper.title: Smarter and Cheaper at Once: Byte-Exact KV-Cache Grafting Turns a Frozen Small Model into a Verified-Knowledge Flywheel
paper.abstract: We report a way to make a frozen small language model both more capable and dramatically cheaper at once, without changing any weights. Verified knowledge is deposited once as a byte-exact key-value (KV) state artifact and later restored, by graft, into a fresh inference context. The restore is bit-exact: under a pinned deterministic configuration, the grafted logits are byte-for-byte identical to a fresh computation (SHA-256 equality), with zero KL divergence and 100% argmax agreement over fift

summary.core_problem: 如何在不改动模型权重的前提下，把已验证知识以可复用的 KV 状态形式注入推理过程，同时保持数值完全一致。
summary.importance: 这是推理侧方法创新，核心不是训练而是 KV-cache 的可移植与可验证复用。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它把“知识存储”从权重迁移到状态，提供了另一种看待参数记忆与外部记忆边界的方式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 byte-exact KV-cache grafting：先把已验证知识或解题轨迹计算成字节级精确的 KV 状态工件，再在新上下文中恢复并拼接。作者强调在固定确定性配置下，只有 own-position graft 能在带浮点 RoPE 的模型上实现数值精确恢复；并用 SHA-256、一致 logits、零 KL、100% argmax agreement 验证重放正确性。
summary.experiments: 在 12B 和 31B 两个模型规模、两种 GPU 目标上验证 bit-exact replay。AIME 2025 上，冻结 Gemma-4-12B 借助 verified solution library 从 80.0% 提升到 93.3%，高于其 31B sibling 的 89.2% 锚点。摘要还提到 recurring case 上，原模型从未解出的 8 道题在 graft 后可被解决。实验亮点在于 exactness 验证和知识库复用，但任务面较窄，主要是数学题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to inject verified knowledge into inference via reusable KV states, without changing model weights and while preserving exact numerical equivalence.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side method paper, not a training one. Its value to pretraining researchers is conceptual: it shifts part of “knowledge storage” from parameters to reusable state artifacts, which is useful when thinking about the boundary between parametric memory and external memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes byte-exact KV-cache grafting: compute a verified knowledge state once, store it as a KV artifact, and restore/graft it into a fresh context later. Under a pinned deterministic setup, the restored computation is claimed to be bit-exact. The paper argues that own-position graft is the only numerically exact operating point for models with floating-point RoPE, and verifies replay with SHA-256 equality, identical logits, zero KL, and 100% argmax agreement.
summary_en.experiments: Byte-exact replay is verified on 12B and 31B models across two GPU targets. On AIME 2025, frozen Gemma-4-12B improves from 80.0% to 93.3% with a verified solution library, exceeding a 31B sibling anchor at 89.2%. The recurring-case result also shows gains on problems the base model never solves. The setup is narrow, mostly math, but the exactness claim is the main technical point.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“状态可复用且可验真”这个点值得看；重点读 exactness 条件和 own-position graft，别被 AIME 分数带偏。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the reusable-and-verifiable state idea is worth your attention; read the exactness conditions and own-position graft, not the AIME headline.

paper.title: LeRoPE: Learnable RoPE Frequencies Improve Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Rotary Positional Encodings (RoPE) are currently the most popular positional encodings used in modern language models. RoPE rotates two-dimensional chunks of query and key vectors, operating as a function of their relative positional offset. The position-wise rates of rotation in RoPE typically follow a geometric sequence specified by a fixed base-frequency hyperparameter. Prior work has improved performance by either increasing this parameter to slow rotation or by applying RoPE to only a subse

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个长期被当作超参数的问题：RoPE 的频率谱是否应该固定为手工设定的几何序列。标准做法把 base frequency 视为架构常数，或者通过 partial RoPE、调大 base 等方式做离线调参；但这些方法都默认“频率形状先验”是对的。论文要回答的是：如果直接把每个频带的频率当作可学习参数，模型会不会学出更合适的位置谱，且这种改动是否在不同规模上稳定带来语言建模收益。作者的结论是肯定的：只增加极少参数，每个频带一个标量，就能在 52M 到 2.5B 的从头训练模型上稳定优于标准 RoPE，并且学出的频率结构在不同规模和随机种子下高度一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在“又一个位置编码变体”，而在两个更具体的点。第一，它说明 RoPE 里最关键的设计量之一——频率分布——并不需要完全手工指定，模型自己能学出更合适的谱，而且收益在从小模型到十亿级模型都存在。对于大规模预训练 recipe，这意味着一个几乎零成本、低风险的改动可以换来可测的 compute 节省。摘要给出的量化结果是：在 2.5B 规模上，标准 RoPE 需要多 3.4% 的训练算力才能追平 LeRoPE。第二，它提供了一个关于“位置与语义如何在频带中分工”的更细观察：训练后会出现一个 dominant positional band，强烈承担位置贡献，而其他慢频带更多保留内容匹配能力。这对理解 partial RoPE、NoPE、长上下文 base scaling 为什么有效，有直接解释力，也会影响后续对可学习位置编码、频谱分配、甚至 head specialization 的研究。
summary.technical_approach:
方法非常克制。作者没有改 attention 形式，也没有引入复杂的相对位置网络，而是在标准 RoPE 上只做一件事：把每个二维频带对应的旋转频率从固定常数改成可学习标量。按文中设定，每个模型只多 32 个参数，说明他们是在每个 head dimension 的频带层面共享这组可学习频率，而不是为每层每头单独学习一大堆参数。这样做保留了 RoPE 的核心性质：query-key 内积仍然只依赖相对位置偏移；同时把“几何频率序列是否合适”交给训练自己决定。

从全文描述看，LeRoPE 的关键不是简单“让频率自由”，而是保留了 RoPE 的结构归纳偏置，只放松最值得放松的一小部分。相比直接改成 learned absolute embedding，它仍然是相对位置编码，因而不会丢掉 RoPE 在长度泛化和 attention 结构上的优点。相比 partial RoPE，它不是手工决定哪些低频带不旋转，而是让优化过程自己决定哪些频带应更慢、近似不旋转，哪些频带应承担更强的位置变化。相比单纯调大 base，它不是对整个频谱做统一缩放，而是允许非均匀重排频率谱。论文分析部分显示，模型最终学出的频率 profile 不是任意散乱的，而是跨尺度、跨种子都很稳定，这说明优化找到的是数据与架构共同偏好的谱形，而不是偶然过拟合。

另一个值得注意的技术点是作者对 attention logits 的频带分解分析。他们不是只报告 perplexity 改善，而是把不同频带对 logits 的位置性贡献拆开，发现会涌现一个 dominant positional band。这个现象很关键，因为它暗示标准 RoPE 的“多频带均匀承担位置编码”并不符合训练后模型的实际使用方式；模型更像是在少数频带上集中编码位置信号，在其他频带上保留更稳定的语义匹配空间。LeRoPE 的收益，很可能来自它让这种分工更容易形成。
summary.experiments:
实验是一个从 52M 到 2.5B 的训练阶梯，全部从头训练，用来检验收益是否随规模稳定。核心结果有两类。

第一类是语言建模主指标。LeRoPE 在所有规模上都优于标准 RoPE。摘要里给出的最明确数字是：在最大 2.5B 模型上，标准 RoPE 需要额外 3.4% 的训练算力才能达到 LeRoPE 的性能。这种表述比单点 perplexity 更有意义，因为它直接说明这是一个 compute-efficient 的 recipe 改动，而不是只在某个 checkpoint 上偶然领先。

第二类是机制分析。作者比较不同随机种子、不同模型规模下学到的频率参数，发现频率 profile 高度一致，说明学习到的不是不稳定的自由度。更重要的是 attention logit 分解结果：会出现一个单独的频带，对位置相关项贡献显著更大，被作者称为 dominant positional band。结合文中对慢频带的讨论，可以推断 LeRoPE 往往会把大部分频带推向更慢、更接近内容通道的状态，同时保留少数频带承担清晰的位置锚点。

从摘要和引言可见，论文还把结果放到 partial RoPE、调 base、NoPE 等已有观察的脉络里解释。精读时要重点找正文中的 scaling 曲线、learned frequency 可视化、以及 attention logit 按 band 分解的图。这几部分比单纯的验证集损失更能说明为什么会提升。

目前给出的全文片段没有列出全部训练 token 数、上下文长度、数据集名称和完整消融表。阅读原文时需要补齐这些具体数字，尤其是：每个规模的训练 token、是否控制了 FLOPs 完全一致、与 partial RoPE / tuned base 的直接对比幅度、以及长上下文外推是否也有测量。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“先结果，后机制”来读。先看实验总表和 scaling 曲线，确认收益是否在所有规模都稳定，以及 3.4% compute gap 是如何测出来的。然后直接看 learned frequency profile 的图，观察它和标准几何频谱的偏离方向：是整体变慢，还是只重排少数频带。接着看 attention logit 的 band-wise 分解，这是全文最有信息量的分析部分，能帮助理解 dominant positional band 的含义。

方法部分本身不长，重点不是公式复杂度，而是参数化选择：每个频带学一个标量，为什么还能保留相对位置性质，为什么比调 base 更灵活、比完全自由的位置编码更稳。若你做预训练 recipe，这篇最值得深挖的是它和 partial RoPE / NoPE 的关系，因为它提供了一个数据驱动版本的“哪些维度该承载位置，哪些维度该保留语义”。

预计泛读 25 到 40 分钟足够抓住主结论；如果要复现或决定是否纳入训练栈，需要再仔细看附录里的初始化、约束方式、学习率处理、以及不同规模下频率收敛形态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits a design choice that has mostly been treated as a fixed hyperparameter: the frequency spectrum in RoPE. Standard RoPE uses a hand-crafted geometric progression controlled by a base frequency. Later variants improved performance by tuning the base or by disabling rotation for part of the spectrum, but they still assume the shape of the spectrum should be manually specified. This work asks a simpler question: what happens if the frequencies themselves are learned during pretraining? The answer is that learning one scalar per frequency band consistently improves language modeling across models from 52M to 2.5B parameters, while adding only a negligible number of parameters.
summary_en.importance: Its significance is practical and conceptual. Practically, it is a near-zero-cost recipe change with measurable compute benefit. The abstract reports that at 2.5B scale, standard RoPE needs 3.4% more training compute to match LeRoPE. That is the kind of gain that matters in large pretraining runs because it comes without architectural disruption. Conceptually, the paper sharpens the picture of how positional and semantic information are distributed across RoPE bands. The learned models consistently develop a single dominant positional band, while slower bands appear to preserve content matching. This helps explain why partial RoPE, NoPE-like behavior in some dimensions, and base scaling for long context often work in practice.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is deliberately minimal. Instead of changing attention or introducing a new positional network, the paper keeps the RoPE mechanism and replaces fixed band frequencies with learnable scalars. In the reported setup this adds only 32 parameters per model, which suggests the learned frequencies are shared at the band level rather than expanded per layer and per head. The key point is that the relative-position property of RoPE is preserved: the rotated query-key inner product still depends only on relative offset, but the spectrum is no longer forced to follow a predetermined geometric schedule.

What makes the approach interesting is not just added flexibility, but selective relaxation of the right inductive bias. Compared with learned absolute embeddings, LeRoPE remains a relative positional encoding and therefore keeps the structural advantages of RoPE. Compared with partial RoPE, it does not require manually deciding which low-frequency bands should stop rotating. Compared with changing the base, it does not apply a uniform rescaling to the whole spectrum; it allows non-uniform redistribution across bands. The analysis shows that the learned spectra are highly consistent across scales and random seeds, which argues against the improvement being a fragile optimization artifact.

A second technical contribution is the analysis of attention logits by frequency band. Rather than stopping at perplexity, the paper decomposes positional contributions across bands and finds the emergence of a dominant positional band. This suggests that trained models do not use the RoPE spectrum uniformly. Instead, they seem to concentrate explicit positional signaling in a small part of the spectrum while leaving other bands closer to content channels. LeRoPE appears to help the model discover this allocation more efficiently.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup is a scale ladder from 52M to 2.5B parameters, all trained from scratch. The main empirical result is simple and strong: LeRoPE outperforms standard RoPE at every scale. The clearest quantitative statement in the abstract is that at 2.5B scale, standard RoPE requires 3.4% more compute to match LeRoPE. That framing is more informative than a single validation-loss delta because it directly translates into pretraining efficiency.

The analysis results are equally important. Learned frequency profiles are highly consistent across random seeds and model sizes, which indicates that the optimization is finding a stable preferred spectrum rather than exploiting arbitrary extra degrees of freedom. The paper also shows that one band emerges with a much larger positional contribution to the attention logits than the others, termed the dominant positional band. This supports the view that the useful role of the RoPE spectrum is not evenly distributed.

From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper situates its findings relative to partial RoPE, base tuning, and NoPE. When reading the full paper, the most important figures to inspect are the scaling curves, the learned-frequency visualizations, and the band-wise logit decomposition. Those explain the gain better than the headline language-modeling metric alone.

The excerpt does not include all training details such as total tokens, context length, dataset names, or the full ablation table. Those should be checked in the full paper, especially direct comparisons against tuned-base RoPE and partial RoPE under matched FLOP budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the main scaling results and verify that the gain is consistent across the full model ladder. Then look at how the 3.4% compute gap is measured. After that, go straight to the learned-frequency plots and compare them with the standard geometric spectrum: is the change mostly a global slowing, or a selective reshaping of a few bands? The next section to read carefully is the band-wise attention-logit analysis, because that is where the dominant positional band is identified.

The method section itself should be quick to read. The important questions are not mathematical complexity but parameterization and invariance: why one scalar per band is enough, how the relative-position property is preserved, and why this is a safer modification than fully learned positional embeddings. If your interest is pretraining recipe design, the most useful angle is the connection to partial RoPE and NoPE. LeRoPE can be read as a data-driven version of deciding which dimensions should carry position and which should remain semantically stable.

A skim should take about 25 to 40 minutes. If you are considering adoption, spend extra time on the appendix for initialization, constraints on the learned frequencies, optimizer treatment, and convergence patterns across scales.

recommendation.zh: 位置编码的扎实改进，全尺度验证有效，应立刻在内部预训练ablation中加入LeRoPE对照，重点看2.5B规模的FLOPs等价性实验。
recommendation.en: A solid positional encoding improvement validated across all scales — add LeRoPE to internal pretraining ablations immediately, focus on the 2.5B FLOP-equivalence experiments.

paper.title: FastTPS: An Optimized Method for LLM Token Phase for AI accelerators
paper.abstract: The popularity of large language models (LLMs) escalates an ongoing demand for effective inference. However, due to the sequential processing of tokens during the token phase in decoder-only LLMs inference, the inherent low parallelism leads to reduced throughput and suboptimal utilization of the computing units on artificial intelligence (AI) accelerators, particularly when handling long-sequence inputs that impose significant memory overhead. Recently, many reported methods have been developed

summary.core_problem: LLM 推理的 token 阶段（解码阶段）每步只生成一个 token，并行度低、访存密集，AI 加速器的算力利用率低；同时 KV Cache 的拼接操作带来额外数据搬运，MLP 部分也缺乏针对 token 阶段的系统性优化。
summary.importance: 这是一篇面向通用 AI 加速器（NPU 类）的推理系统优化工作，核心是 token 阶段的数据流和算子融合优化，属于推理工程范畴，对预训练研究本身没有直接影响，但对理解 LLM 推理瓶颈和硬件友好的架构设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: FastTPS 包含三个核心组件：(1) 全局 KV Cache 管理（GKVC）：采用三维静态内存布局，新生成的 KV 直接写入预留位置，省去每步的 concat 内存重排，减少数据搬运；(2) TPSFLAT：在 FLAT 注意力思路基础上，针对 token 阶段特点融合更多算子（包括 RoPE），提升运算强度，并配合三级缓存设计数据分块策略提升并行度；(3) 交错布局的 MLP 多算子融合：将 gate 和 up 权重按交错布局排列，通过细粒度矩阵切分和重排，为多算子融合创造条件，降低 I/O 开销。
summary.experiments: 在 AMD Ryzen AI 300 系列 NPU 上验证，覆盖多个主流 LLM。论文给出的实验部分不完整，仅提到相比标准实现有性能提升，具体加速比和精度数据未在提供的内容中展开。
summary.reading_guide: 如果关注推理系统优化，重点看三个核心组件的设计细节（GKVC 的内存布局、TPSFLAT 的算子融合策略、MLP 交错布局方案）；如果主要关注预训练，可快速浏览方法部分了解推理侧瓶颈对架构的反哺。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: During the token (decoding) phase of LLM inference, only one token is generated per step, resulting in low parallelism, memory-bound execution, and poor compute utilization on AI accelerators. Additionally, KV Cache concatenation introduces extra data movement, and the MLP portion lacks systematic optimization tailored to the token phase.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference system optimization work targeting general-purpose AI accelerators (NPUs), focused on dataflow and operator fusion for the token phase. It falls into the inference engineering domain and has no direct impact on pretraining research, but is useful for understanding LLM inference bottlenecks and hardware-friendly architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: FastTPS consists of three core components: (1) Global KV Cache management (GKVC): a 3D static memory layout where newly generated KV entries are written directly to reserved slots, eliminating per-step concat memory reorganization and reducing data movement; (2) TPSFLAT: building on the FLAT attention concept, fusing more operators (including RoPE) specifically for the token phase to increase operational intensity, combined with a data tiling strategy aligned with a three-level cache hierarchy to improve parallelism; (3) Multi-op fusion for MLP with interlaced gate-up weight layout: gate and up weights are arranged in an interlaced layout, and fine-grained matrix partitioning and rearrangement enable multi-op fusion, reducing I/O overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on AMD Ryzen AI 300-series NPUs across several mainstream LLMs. The provided text contains only partial experimental results; it mentions performance improvements over the standard implementation, but specific speedup numbers and accuracy metrics are not included in the available content.
summary_en.reading_guide: If focused on inference system optimization, read the three core components in detail — GKVC memory layout, TPSFLAT operator fusion strategy, and the interlaced MLP weight layout. If primarily interested in pretraining, a quick skim of the method section suffices to understand how inference-side constraints feed back into architecture choices. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只读实现细节和误差表；若没有端到端吞吐与数值漂移数据，就把它当服务侧工程信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the implementation details and error tables; without end-to-end throughput and drift numbers, treat it as a serving-engineering signal.

paper.title: Jet-Long: Efficient Long-Context Extension with Dynamic Bifocal RoPE
paper.abstract: Modern LLMs are increasingly deployed in long-context applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, repository-level coding, and agentic workflows whose accumulated reasoning and tool traces routinely push the input an order of magnitude past the pretraining window, making zero-shot context extension the dominant deployment path for open-weight checkpoints. Most existing zero-shot methods fix a single rescaling factor up front, so an aggressive factor sacrifices short-context fidelity whi

summary.core_problem: 现有零样本长上下文扩展方法需要预先固定一个缩放因子：激进因子会损害短上下文保真度，保守因子无法支撑超长上下文；近期的长度自适应变种又依赖逐模型拟合或距离相关调度，落地成本和推理开销较高。需要一种无需调参、同时兼顾短上下文保真和长上下文扩展能力、且推理开销低的零样本上下文扩展方案。
summary.importance: 1）提出分析式推导的动态双焦点RoPE方法，无需逐模型拟合超参数，降低了长上下文扩展的落地成本；2）双窗口设计在完全保留预训练短上下文行为的同时实现长上下文零样本扩展，为预训练模型的长上下文部署提供了更优的零样本选项；3）高效的内核设计将推理开销控制在极低水平，对长上下文模型的推理系统架构设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）动态双焦点RoPE设计：保留一个本地窗口使用原生RoPE，完全复现预训练模型的短上下文行为；远程窗口的分组大小根据当前序列长度L和预训练窗口w_pretrained分析式推导：G = max(1, ⌈L / w_pretrained⌉)，确保远程位置的旋转角始终处于预训练分布内，无需逐模型调参。2）容斥式注意力合并机制，通过三次FlashAttention调用融合本地与远程窗口的注意力结果，配合实时RoPE校正旋转，生成阶段无需修改KV缓存。3）融合为单个CuTe内核，Prefill性能接近FlashAttention4，生成阶段开销不超过4%。
summary.experiments: 1）在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B三个规模的模型上测试，上下文长度最高覆盖128K；2）在RULER基准上，相比最强零样本基线分别提升4.79/2.18/2.03个百分点；3）在HELMET-RAG和PG-19困惑度测试中达到最优或持平水平；4）唯一超参数本地窗口大小w0具有鲁棒性，方法可直接迁移到Jet-Nemotron混合架构上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：第1章引言（现有方法的缺陷总结，约10分钟）、第3章方法（动态因子推导与双窗口注意力合并设计，约20分钟）、第4章实验（核心性能结果与开销分析，约10分钟）；总阅读时间约40-45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing zero-shot long-context extension methods require a fixed rescaling factor chosen upfront: an aggressive factor sacrifices short-context fidelity, while a conservative one fails at very long contexts. Recent length-adaptive variants rely on per-model fitting or distance-dependent schedules, leading to higher deployment cost and inference overhead. A tuning-free zero-shot context extension method is needed that preserves short-context fidelity, enables long-context scaling, and maintains low inference overhead.
summary_en.importance: 1) Proposes an analytically derived dynamic bifocal RoPE method that requires no per-model hyperparameter fitting, reducing the deployment cost of long-context extension. 2) The dual-window design fully preserves pretrained short-context behavior while enabling zero-shot long-context extension, providing a stronger zero-shot option for deploying pretrained models at longer context lengths. 3) The efficient kernel design keeps inference overhead extremely low, offering reference for long-context inference system architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Dynamic bifocal RoPE design: a local window retains native RoPE to exactly reproduce the pretrained model's short-context behavior; the remote window uses a group size G analytically derived from the current sequence length L and pretrained window w_pretrained: G = max(1, ⌈L / w_pretrained⌉), ensuring remote rotation angles stay within the pretrained distribution without per-model tuning. 2) Inclusion-exclusion attention merge mechanism that combines local and remote window attention via three FlashAttention passes, paired with on-the-fly RoPE correction rotation that leaves the KV cache untouched during generation. 3) Fused into a single CuTe kernel, reaching near-FlashAttention4 prefill performance and ≤4% generation overhead.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B models up to 128K context length. 2) Outperforms the strongest zero-shot baseline on RULER by +4.79/+2.18/+2.03 percentage points for the three model sizes respectively. 3) Achieves best or tied performance on HELMET-RAG and PG-19 perplexity benchmarks. 4) The only hyperparameter w0 (local window size) is robust across settings, and the method transfers unchanged to the hybrid Jet-Nemotron architecture.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Chapter 1 (summary of limitations in existing methods, ~10 min), Chapter 3 (derivation of the dynamic factor and dual-window attention merge design, ~20 min), and Chapter 4 (core performance results and overhead analysis, ~10 min). Total estimated reading time: 40–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Song Han 团队的长上下文免微调外推工作，动态双焦点 RoPE 的思路很巧妙，值得关注其 CUDA 实现细节和实际加速比。
recommendation.en: A tuning-free long-context extrapolation work from Song Han's group. The dynamic bifocal RoPE idea is clever; worth checking the CUDA implementation details and actual speedup.

paper.title: How Data Shapes RoPE Frequency Usage: From Positional Scale Matching to Length Generalization
paper.abstract: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) provide transformers with a fixed grid of positional frequencies, yet trained models use these frequencies highly non-uniformly. We study what determines this frequency usage and propose a data-centered explanation: RoPE frequencies are selected to match the relative-distance structure of the training data. Viewing each frequency as a positional lens, we formalize a field-resolution tradeoff and show that, for a data-induced dependency profile of width $W$, the

summary.core_problem: 现有研究观察到训练后的Transformer对RoPE提供的固定频率网格使用极不均匀，但始终没有解释频率选择的决定机制，也没有清晰说明位置插值（PI）实现长度外推的生效边界，领域内长期存在“高频编码位置、低频编码语义”的模糊经验认知，缺乏定量的理论支撑。
summary.importance: 这是少有的从训练数据结构出发解释RoPE频率使用规律的工作，将注意力中的位置归纳偏置从固定架构属性重新定义为受训练数据塑造的习得属性，推导的频率匹配原则和PI适用条件可以直接指导RoPE超参数设计、预训练数据长度配比、长上下文适配方案选择，解释了此前多个仅靠经验总结无法说明的长上下文性能现象。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将每个RoPE频率定义为存在“视野-分辨率”权衡的位置透镜：高频的局部位置分辨率高，但相位缠绕速度快、有效感知视野短；低频的覆盖范围广，但对邻近位置的区分度低。其次定义训练数据的位置依赖剖面，即序列中不同相对距离上存在任务相关依赖的分布宽度W。通过分析注意力分数的位置对比度，证明频率匹配原则：对于宽度为W的依赖剖面，模型最优选择的频率满足θ* ∝ 1/W，训练过程会自动选择与数据依赖尺度匹配的频率带。在此基础上分析位置插值的作用机制：PI将每个频率的有效视野扩大α倍、局部分辨率降低α倍，仅当测试场景的依赖剖面是训练剖面的α倍拉伸（即满足自相似性）时，PI才能将训练阶段习得的最优频率映射到测试场景的最优频率，实现有效的长度外推。研究还设计了注意力分数级的能量度量来量化频率使用程度，排除了参数初始化、输入特异性波动的干扰，证明频率使用模式是训练收敛后稳定的、由数据决定的属性。
summary.experiments: 在合成数据上的控制实验验证：构造固定依赖宽度W的任务，模型习得的频率选择确实与1/W呈线性匹配关系。在自然语言数据上的验证显示：自然语言的多尺度依赖结构，恰好对应现有大模型中频率使用集中在中低频段的现象；系统性改变训练数据的依赖尺度，会使模型的频率使用分布发生对应偏移。PI边界条件的验证实验显示：PI在依赖结构满足自相似性的自然语言生成任务上效果稳定，在依赖尺度不随上下文长度拉伸的任务（如固定相对距离的“大海捞针”检索）上收益有限甚至带来性能下降。消融实验排除了QK范数初始化、输入差异的影响，证明收敛后的频率使用模式在不同输入下高度稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 这是需要精读的论文。重点关注三个核心部分：一是频率透镜的视野-分辨率权衡定义，以及频率匹配原则的推导，这是整个工作的理论支点；二是合成数据上的控制实验，其因果识别的实验设计有很强的参考价值；三是PI生效的自相似条件，结论可以直接落地到长上下文训练和适配的工程决策中。图表部分重点关注频率-依赖宽度匹配曲线、不同训练数据下的频率分布偏移、不同任务结构下的PI效果对比。值得延伸思考的方向包括：频率匹配原则是否可以用于指导预训练阶段的数据长度课程设计，是否可以解释YaRN、NTK-aware缩放等RoPE修正方法的效果边界。预计精读时间45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Trained Transformers exhibit highly non-uniform usage of the fixed frequency grid provided by RoPE, but the mechanism driving frequency selection remains poorly understood. Existing work lacks clear boundary conditions for when position interpolation (PI) enables length generalization, leaving the vague, untested heuristic that 'high frequencies encode position, low frequencies encode semantics' as the dominant informal account of RoPE behavior.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a data-centered, quantitative framework for RoPE frequency selection, reframing positional inductive bias in attention as a learned property shaped by training data structure rather than a fixed architectural feature. The derived frequency matching principle and PI applicability conditions provide concrete guidance for RoPE hyperparameter design, pretraining data length mixture, and long-context adaptation, resolving multiple previously unexplained empirical observations about long-context model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each RoPE frequency is modeled as a positional lens with an inherent field-resolution tradeoff: higher frequencies offer sharper local position discrimination but have shorter effective range due to fast phase wrapping, while lower frequencies cover longer ranges but have coarser resolution for nearby positions. The work defines the positional dependency profile of training data as the width W of the distribution of task-relevant dependencies across relative positions. Analysis of positional contrast in attention scores proves a frequency matching principle: for a dependency profile of width W, the optimal selected frequency scales as θ* ∝ 1/W, meaning training automatically selects frequency bands matched to the dependency scales present in the data. The analysis of PI shows the operation scales each frequency's effective field by a factor of α while reducing resolution by the same factor. PI enables valid length generalization only if test-time dependency profiles are an α-stretched (self-similar) version of training-time profiles, which maps training-optimal frequencies to test-optimal frequencies. The work also introduces an attention score-level energy metric to quantify frequency usage, controlling for initialization effects and input-specific variation to show frequency usage patterns are stable after convergence and determined by training data.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled synthetic experiments confirm that models trained on tasks with fixed dependency width W reliably select frequencies linearly proportional to 1/W. Natural language experiments show the multi-scale dependency structure of text explains the observed concentration of frequency usage in mid-low bands in pretrained LLMs; systematically shifting the dependency scale of training data produces corresponding shifts in learned frequency distributions. Validation of PI boundary conditions shows PI delivers consistent gains on self-similar natural language generation tasks, but provides limited benefit or even harms performance on tasks where dependency scale does not stretch with context length, such as fixed-distance needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. Ablations rule out QK norm initialization and input variability as explanations for non-uniform frequency use, showing frequency usage patterns are highly stable across inputs after convergence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Must-read. Focus on three core sections: 1) The definition of the frequency lens field-resolution tradeoff and derivation of the frequency matching principle, which forms the core theoretical contribution; 2) The controlled synthetic experiments, which establish a causal link between data structure and frequency selection with a clean experimental design; 3) The self-similarity condition for PI effectiveness, which maps directly to practical engineering decisions for long-context training and adaptation. Pay close attention to plots showing frequency-dependency width matching, frequency distribution shifts under different training data regimes, and PI performance across task structures. Open directions worth exploring include whether the frequency matching principle can guide pretraining data length curriculum design, and whether it explains performance boundaries of modified RoPE methods such as YaRN and NTK-aware scaling. Estimated deep reading time: 45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变对RoPE频率选择机制的认知，预训练中做长度泛化、数据配比ablation时必须参考§3-§4的结论
recommendation.en: Rewrites the prior on RoPE frequency selection; §3-§4 conclusions are mandatory for length generalization and data mixture ablations in pretraining.

paper.title: RotateAttention: RoPE-Aware Rotation and Range Rectification for INT4 Quantized Attention in Video Generation
paper.abstract: In \textbf{DiT-based video generation models equipped with 3D Rotary Position Embeddings (3D RoPE)}, the attention mechanism remains a primary computational bottleneck due to its quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. While quantized \textbf{FlashAttention} offers a promising path toward hardware acceleration, existing low-bit quantization methods overlook two critical challenges in this setting: \textbf{1)} applying online rotation matrices -- a widely used technique for mitigati

summary.core_problem: 在使用 3D RoPE 的 DiT 视频生成模型中，将注意力模块做 INT4 量化加速，同时避免 RoPE 与低比特旋转/量化策略冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和低比特注意力优化。虽然目标是视频生成 DiT，不是 LLM，但 RoPE-aware attention quantization、outlier 处理和 FlashAttention 量化路径对长序列 LLM 推理有可迁移的工程信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RotateAttention，一个 mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention 方案。核心观察是 Q/K outlier 分布受 3D RoPE 维度划分显著影响；方法针对 RoPE 调整在线旋转矩阵使用方式，并对非负注意力矩阵 P 的量化范围做 rectification，减少对称量化浪费动态范围的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频模型规模、视频长度、硬件平台、速度提升或质量指标变化。实验应围绕 DiT-based video generation with 3D RoPE，对比常规低比特量化和量化 FlashAttention 的效率与生成质量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology 及独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets INT4 quantized attention for DiT-based video generation models using 3D RoPE, where RoPE interacts poorly with common rotation-based outlier mitigation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for low-bit attention. Although the target is video DiT rather than LLMs, the RoPE-aware treatment of Q/K outliers and quantized FlashAttention has transferable engineering value for long-sequence models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes RotateAttention, a mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention method. The key observation is that Q/K outlier distributions are strongly affected by the dimensional partitioning of 3D RoPE. The method adapts online rotations to RoPE and rectifies the quantization range for the non-negative attention matrix P to avoid wasting half of the symmetric INT4 range.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, video lengths, hardware setup, speedups, or quality deltas. The evaluation is expected to compare RotateAttention with existing low-bit and quantized FlashAttention baselines on DiT video generation models with 3D RoPE.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations are The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法图就够；RoPE 与 INT4 attention 的冲突是真问题，但视频 DiT 结论需谨慎迁移到 LLM。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and method figure; the RoPE–INT4 attention conflict is real, but results from video DiTs should be transferred to LLMs cautiously.

paper.title: RoPEMover: Depth-Aware Object Relocation via Positional Embeddings

Existing approaches are not well suited to this setting and often fail to preserve such scene-level consistency. summary.core_problem: 如何在单张图像中移动物体并保持场景级别的几何一致性（如遮挡、阴影、反射）？
summary.importance: 提出了一种通过直接操作 Diffusion Transformer 中的旋转位置编码（RoPE）来实现几何感知物体移动的新方法，展示了 RoPE 在空间结构控制上的潜力。
summary.technical_approach: 将 2D RoPE 扩展为编码 3D 空间结构的深度感知（depth-aware）形式。通过显式操作这种结构化空间场来引导受控运动，使用合成数据和少量真实图像进行参数高效微调（PEFT）。
summary.experiments: 在少量真实监督下，能在较大空间位移下保持物体身份和场景一致性。
summary.authors_note: Cohere 团队工作，探索了 DiT 中位置编码的显式控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to move an object in a single image while maintaining scene-level geometric consistency (e.g., occlusions, shadows, reflections)?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel method for geometry-aware object motion by directly manipulating Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) in Diffusion Transformers, demonstrating RoPE's potential for spatial structure control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Extends 2D RoPE into a depth-aware formulation encoding 3D spatial structure. Explicitly manipulates this structured spatial field to induce controlled motion, trained via parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) on synthetic data and a small set of real images.
summary_en.experiments: Preserves object identity and scene consistency under large spatial displacements with minimal real supervision.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Cohere, exploring the explicit control capabilities of positional embeddings in DiT.

recommendation.zh: 将 RoPE 扩展到 3D 深度感知并用于 DiT 的空间控制，对多模态生成和位置编码设计有一定启发，但偏 CV 下游任务。
recommendation.en: Extends RoPE to 3D depth-aware formulation for spatial control in DiT. Offers some inspiration for multimodal generation and positional encoding design, but leans towards CV downstream tasks.

paper.title: RoPE-Aware Bit Allocation for KV-Cache Quantization
paper.abstract: Existing low-bit KV-cache quantizers often treat each cached key as a flat vector. Under RoPE, however, a key's contribution to a future attention logit decomposes into a position-dependent sum over two-dimensional frequency blocks. This makes key-cache quantization a block-wise bit-allocation problem: high-energy RoPE blocks are more sensitive to quantization error and should receive more bits. We introduce Block-GTQ, a RoPE-aware bit allocator for key-cache quantization built on TurboQuant-MSE

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里一个很具体但常被粗糙处理的问题：RoPE 模型中的 key cache 量化，不应被看成普通向量压缩，而应被看成“对未来 attention logit 影响不同的频率块之间如何分配比特”的问题。现有低比特 KV-cache 方法大多把每个 key 当成平坦向量，优化重建误差；但在 RoPE 下，query-key logit 是按 2 维旋转频率块分解的，不同 block 对未来 logits 的敏感度并不一样。结果是，统一 bit allocation 会把预算浪费在低影响 block 上，同时压坏真正决定注意力分布的高能量 block，尤其在长上下文和推理任务上会出现性能塌陷。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的意义主要不在“又一个量化技巧”，而在于它把 KV-cache 压缩目标重新对齐到了模型真正使用 key 的方式上：不是最小化向量 MSE，而是更接近最小化 RoPE attention logit 误差。这种目标重写很有启发性，因为它说明推理侧压缩如果忽略预训练时引入的结构性归纳偏置，往往会在表面压缩率相同的情况下造成完全不同的功能退化。对长上下文 serving 来说，这项工作给出了一条很实用的路线：在不改模型、不引入 recent buffer 依赖的前提下，仅通过更合理的 bit allocation 就能显著改善低比特 K-cache 的可用性。对预训练研究员而言，更重要的启发是：RoPE 不是“后处理细节”，它改变了表示的误差几何，任何压缩、蒸馏、甚至训练时正则都可能需要围绕这种 block structure 重新设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Block-GTQ。它建立在 TurboQuant-MSE 之上，但不再对整个 key head 统一分配 bit，而是对每个 layer、每个 KV head 内的 RoPE 2D block 做整数 bit allocation。论文先从 RoPE attention 写出 logit 形式：对于相对位置 Δ，logit 是 q^T R_Δ k，可拆成多个 2×2 旋转块项之和。于是 key 的量化误差对 logit 的影响天然是 block-wise 的。基于这个观察，作者为每个 block 构造了一个无需标签的 energy score，来自 Q/K 激活统计，用来近似该 block 对未来 query-key 信号的重要性。然后结合 TQ-MSE 的经验误差率律 4^{-b}，把“给某个 block 多 1 bit 能减少多少预期误差”写成边际收益，并在固定平均 bit budget 下做 greedy integer allocation。分到相同比特宽度的 block 再复用原始 TQ-MSE 的局部编码器，因此实现代价不高。值向量 V 没有参与 RoPE key-logit 计算，所以仍然采用 uniform TQ-MSE。这个设计很克制：它不改 attention，不改 cache layout 的语义，只改 K 的 bit 分配策略。论文还实现了 packed-cache serving path，把压缩后的 K/V code 直接用于推理路径，而不是只做离线误差分析。
summary.experiments: 实验分三层。第一层是机制验证：在 10 个模型的诊断面板上，作者比较了相同 K-only bit budget 下 Block-GTQ 与 uniform TQ-MSE 的 RoPE-logit 保真度。在 2 b/dim 和 3 b/dim 两个预算下，per-layer RoPE-logit MAE 相对下降 32% 到 80%，并且在 367/367 个 layer comparison 上全部胜出，说明收益不是少数层驱动，而是相当稳定的结构性改进。第二层是长上下文任务：在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，K2V2 预算下，六任务 NIAH 平均分从 70.6 提升到 97.4；八任务 LongBench-EN 平均分从 36.87 提升到 53.31。这个幅度已经说明 uniform K quantization 在低比特下不是“略差”，而是会明显破坏可用性。第三层是推理与数学任务鲁棒性：在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上，AIME 2024/2025 的 K3V2 设置里，Block-GTQ 达到 51.7/37.5，接近 fp16 的 54.2/37.9，而 uniform TQ-MSE 直接掉到 0.0/0.0。这个结果很关键，因为它说明低比特 key 误差会通过 attention 分布放大，最终把长链推理彻底打坏；而 RoPE-aware allocation 可以显著缓解。系统侧，在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上用 K3V3 Block-GTQ 的 packed path，相比 fp16 FlashAttention2，128K context 下 KV cache 压缩 3.24×，峰值显存从 56.31GB 降到 19.85GB，单请求 decode latency 从 70.96ms 降到 52.95ms；256K 和 512K 时 fp16 baseline 已 OOM，而压缩路径仍可运行，峰值显存分别为 33.42GB 和 60.56GB。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先抓三处。第一，看引言和 RoPE-structured key-cache error 的推导，确认作者为什么坚持“key 量化目标应是 logit preservation 而不是 vector reconstruction”。这是整篇文章最有信息量的地方。第二，看 bit allocation 的公式化部分，重点理解 energy score 的定义、为什么能做到 label-free、以及 4^{-b} 误差率律如何把 allocation 变成 greedy marginal gain 问题。第三，看实验里 AIME 和 LongBench/NIAH 的结果表，这些比单纯 logit MAE 更能说明方法是否真的保住了模型功能。若时间有限，优先读方法章节前半、主结果表、以及 packed serving 的实现说明，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主要贡献。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是 energy profile 是否与预训练阶段不同层的频率利用模式有关；二是这种 block-aware 思路能否迁移到训练时的表示正则、蒸馏损失或 tokenizer 设计上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific but important mismatch in long-context inference: key-cache quantization in RoPE-based models should not be treated as flat vector compression. Under RoPE, a future query-key logit decomposes into a sum over 2D frequency blocks, and different blocks contribute very differently to the final attention score. Existing low-bit KV-cache methods mostly optimize reconstruction error on the key vector itself, which ignores this structured sensitivity. As a result, uniform bit allocation can waste precision on low-impact blocks while under-protecting the blocks that actually control attention logits, leading to severe degradation on long-context and reasoning tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not just a better quantizer. The paper reframes KV-cache compression around the quantity the model actually uses: RoPE attention logits rather than vector MSE. That shift is useful for foundation-model researchers because it shows how inference-time compression can fail when it ignores the representational geometry induced by pretraining choices such as RoPE. In practical serving, the method shows that one can recover much of the utility of low-bit key caches without changing the model or relying on an fp16 recent-key buffer. More broadly, it suggests that RoPE is not a superficial implementation detail; it changes how errors propagate, so compression, distillation, and possibly even training-time regularization may need to respect the same block structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Block-GTQ, is built on TurboQuant-MSE but replaces uniform per-head bit allocation with integer bit allocation over RoPE 2D blocks inside each layer and KV head. The starting point is the RoPE attention logit q^T R_Δ k, which decomposes into a sum of 2×2 rotated block terms. This makes key-cache quantization naturally block-sensitive: quantization error in different blocks perturbs future logits by different amounts. The paper defines a label-free block energy score from Q/K activation statistics to estimate how important each block is for future query-key interactions. It then combines this score with the TQ-MSE empirical error law, where squared error scales roughly as 4^{-b}, to compute the marginal gain of assigning one more bit to a block. Under a fixed average-bit budget, bits are allocated greedily as integers. Blocks with the same assigned width are then encoded using the original TQ-MSE local quantizer, so the implementation remains lightweight. Values are still quantized with uniform TQ-MSE because V does not enter the RoPE key-logit computation. The paper also implements a packed-cache serving path so the compressed K/V codes are used in an actual inference pipeline rather than only in offline analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation has three layers. First, mechanism validation: on a ten-model diagnostic panel, Block-GTQ is compared against uniform TQ-MSE at matched K-only budgets. At both 2 and 3 bits per dimension, it reduces per-layer RoPE-logit MAE by 32% to 80%, and wins all 367/367 layer comparisons at each budget. This indicates a broad structural improvement rather than gains from a few favorable layers. Second, long-context downstream tasks: on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at K2V2, the six-task NIAH average rises from 70.6 to 97.4, and the eight-task LongBench-EN average rises from 36.87 to 53.31 relative to uniform-allocation TQ-MSE. Third, reasoning robustness: on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, AIME 2024/2025 scores at K3V2 are 51.7/37.5 for Block-GTQ, close to fp16 at 54.2/37.9, while uniform TQ-MSE collapses to 0.0/0.0. That result is especially telling because it shows how low-bit key errors can destroy long-chain reasoning once they distort attention distributions, and how RoPE-aware allocation can prevent that failure. On the systems side, with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and a K3V3 packed path, the method achieves 3.24× KV-cache compression at 128K context, reduces peak memory from 56.31GB to 19.85GB, and lowers single-request decode latency from 70.96ms to 52.95ms. At 256K and 512K, the fp16 baseline runs out of memory, while the packed path remains feasible at 33.42GB and 60.56GB peak memory.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the derivation of RoPE-structured key-cache error. That is where the paper makes its central case that key quantization should preserve logits rather than just reconstruct vectors. Second, read the bit-allocation section carefully, especially how the energy score is defined, why it is label-free, and how the 4^{-b} rate law turns allocation into a greedy marginal-gain problem. Third, inspect the AIME and LongBench/NIAH result tables, since they show whether the improved logit fidelity actually preserves model function. If time is limited, the first half of the method section, the main result tables, and the packed-serving implementation notes are enough to capture the contribution in about 25 to 35 minutes. Two deeper follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the learned energy profiles reflect layerwise frequency usage patterns from pretraining, and whether the same block-aware idea could be transferred to training-time regularization, distillation losses, or representation design.

recommendation.zh: RoPE频率块特性是预训练架构设计的核心细节，重点看§3的块能量计算逻辑，可反哺预训练时的RoPE超参与维度分配。
recommendation.en: RoPE frequency block characteristics are a core pre-training architecture detail; focus on §3's block energy calculation logic, which can inform RoPE hyperparameter and dimension allocation during pre-training.
